local: Saved on this device. Sending is not connected yet.
queued: Saved on this device. Your submitted feedback is waiting for confirmation.
synced: Your submitted feedback was received by the playtest team.
draftSaved: Draft saved on this device. Press Send to share it.
failed: Your submitted feedback could not be sent. You can try Send again.
retrying: Your submitted feedback could not be sent. A limited retry is scheduled while this page stays open.
storage: This browser cannot save feedback reliably. Keep this page open and download Excel before leaving. A new player cannot start until saving works.
storageUnsaved: This browser is not saving anything on this device. Keep this page open and download Excel before leaving. Next player on this computer starts over and keeps nothing from this player.
recovery: Some earlier feedback could not be reopened. The original is kept for your instructor to recover.
changed: A new player started in another tab. Reloading to keep players separate.
empty: Your saved comments will appear here.
newConfirm: Start the next player? The next player gets a new game and an empty feedback form, and score sharing starts off again. This player's game and notes stay saved on this device. Only the close-out view for the grown-up running the play-test shows the notes.
newUnsaved: Start the next player? This browser is not saving anything on this device, so this player's game and notes will be gone. To keep the notes, choose Keep playing and download Excel first.
downloadError: Excel could not be downloaded. Keep this page open and try again.
removed: We removed things that look like contact details, names, ages, schools or birthdays. This check can miss things, so please read the note and remove any other names.
check: Grown-up check: I read this note. It has no names, ages, schools, birthdays or contact details.
checkStatus: Nothing is sent until a grown-up ticks the check and chooses Send now.
checkFirst: A grown-up needs to tick the check first. Nothing was sent.
blank: Write a note or choose an answer before sending.
flagged: Please check these words before sending: {words}.
notSent: Not sent yet. Your note is saved on this device. You can press Send to try again.
unsent: Your feedback has not reached the playtest team yet. It is saved on this device. Press Send to try again.
othersWaiting: Notes from earlier players on this device have not been sent. The grown-up running the play-test can send them from the close-out view.
newUnsent: Notes from this player that the playtest team has not received: {count}. They stay saved on this device until they are sent from the close-out view or this device's Pecan Grove data is erased.
playerReady: The next player is ready. The last player's game and notes are saved on this device.
deviceOpen: Privacy and notes on this device
deviceIntro: For grown-ups. Read the privacy notice, see how many notes are saved on this device, or erase everything Pecan Grove saved here.
privacyStored: Saved on this device: each player's game progress, notes, settings and score-sharing choice, the recent game steps of the eight most recent players, and random codes for the player and each note. If a saved record cannot be read, a copy of it is kept for recovery. No names or accounts are needed.
privacySentCloud: What is sent, and when: nothing leaves this device until a grown-up reviews a note and chooses Send. A sent note includes its text with contact details removed, the stop, rating and topic, the language, the game version, the times it was written and its random codes. With the notes goes a short record of that player's session: when it started and last changed, and whether it has ended, with the language, the game version and random codes. Scores are sent only if a grown-up turns on score sharing: with the notes they send, or as soon as a stop is finished if the second box is also on.
privacySentLocal: What is sent: nothing. This copy of the game is not connected to the playtest team. Notes stay on this device until you download or erase them.
privacyWho: Who receives sent notes: the playtest team, in a private Google Sheet. Notes travel through Google Apps Script, a Google service.
privacyContact: Questions about this play-test or about notes already sent? Email akeyvanf@kennesaw.edu and include the player code shown in the feedback panel.
privacyDelete: To delete what this game saved on this device, use Erase all Pecan Grove data on this device below, or clear this site's data in the browser settings. Excel and progress files you saved stay where you saved them.
deviceSummary: Players: {players}. Notes: {notes}. Not received by the playtest team: {waiting}.
deviceCloseout: Notes can be private, so this panel only counts them. The grown-up running the play-test reads them in the close-out view described on the educator sheet.
deviceNone: No notes are saved on this device.
deviceCheck: Grown-up check: I read every note above. They have no names, ages, schools, birthdays or contact details.
deviceSent: The playtest team received every note on this device.
deviceFailed: Notes not received: {count}. They stay saved on this device. Try again later.
deviceLocal: Sending is not connected in this copy. Download Excel to keep these notes.
deviceDownloaded: Excel downloaded for every player on this device.
erase: Erase all Pecan Grove data on this device
eraseConfirm: Erase every player's game, notes and settings on this device? This cannot be undone.
eraseUnsent: Notes not received by the playtest team: {count}. Erasing deletes them. To keep them, the grown-up running the play-test can download them first in the close-out view.
closeoutAsk: The close-out view shows every player's notes on this device. It is only for the grown-up running the play-test. If you are a player, choose Not now.
closeoutYes: I am the grown-up running the play-test
closeoutTitle: Close-out for the grown-up running the play-test
closeoutIntro: Read every player's notes on this device before you send them. The Excel file has each note exactly as it was written, so keep it private.
closeoutChanged: Some notes changed after this list was shown, so it was drawn again. Read it again before you send.
restoreIntro: If Next player was chosen by mistake, bring back an earlier player's game and notes. The player playing now stays saved on this device.
restoreNone: There are no earlier players on this device.
consentScoresAsk: For grown-ups. Scores will be added to the notes you send: the stop number and score, with the language, the time and random codes. Never names. Scores already received cannot be taken back.
consentAutoAsk: For grown-ups. Each score will leave this device as soon as a stop is finished, without a review: the stop number and score, with the language, the time and random codes. Never notes or names.
unavailable: Sending is not connected. Your draft stays on this device.
scoresOnly: Score sharing is off unless a grown-up turns it on.
title: Playtest feedback
introduction: Tell us what you notice while you play. You can leave a separate note for each stop.
privacyLocal: Your draft and saved notes stay on this device. Download an Excel backup before clearing browser data. No name or contact details are needed.
privacyCloud: Drafts stay on this device. Ask a grown-up to review and send a note to the playtest team. Sending includes your note, the stop, the language, the time and random codes for this player and note. Scores are included only with permission. Never include names or contact details.
hint: A few words are enough. Please leave out names, email addresses and other personal details.
shared: Sharing this computer? Choose Next player on this computer before someone else plays. It starts a separate game and feedback session.
